---
title: "Sampling variability in a regression slope"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

The full gas-turbine dataset is one observed collection of operating hours,
not the entire population of possible operating hours. This explorer makes
that idea visible by repeatedly drawing paired AT–NOx observations from the
course data and fitting a new simple-regression line each time.

The draws are a visual thought experiment. They do not replace the
model-based standard error developed in the [slope-inference
notebook](02-testing-a-regression-slope.ipynb); instead, they show why the
fitted slope $hat{\beta}_1$ changes from one plausible dataset to another.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to compare

Hold the sample size fixed and increase the number of samples: the histogram
becomes smoother, but its underlying spread does not shrink. Then increase the
sample size: the fitted-line fan and the slope histogram should become tighter.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="regression-sampling-explorer" class="clt-explorer regression-sampling-explorer" aria-label="Interactive regression sampling-variability explorer">
  <div class="clt-controls">
    <label>
      <span>Observations per fit, <i>n</i> (25–2,000)</span>
      <input id="regression-sampling-size" type="number" min="25" max="2000" step="1" value="300" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Total samples, <i>B</i> (1–1,000)</span>
      <input id="regression-sampling-total" type="number" min="1" max="1000" step="1" value="100" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      Add samples
      <select id="regression-sampling-batch">
        <option value="1">1</option>
        <option value="5">5</option>
        <option value="10" selected>10</option>
        <option value="25">25</option>
        <option value="50">50</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Simulation controls">
    <button id="regression-sampling-add" class="regression-sampling-primary" type="button" disabled>Add samples</button>
    <button id="regression-sampling-run" type="button" disabled>Run remaining samples</button>
    <button id="regression-sampling-reset" type="button" disabled>Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p id="regression-sampling-status" class="clt-status" aria-live="polite">Loading the gas-turbine data…</p>

  <div class="clt-plots">
    <figure class="clt-plot">
      <figcaption><span id="regression-sampling-lines-title">Fitted sample lines</span> <span class="clt-legend"><span class="regression-sampling-line-swatch"></span>sample fits <span class="regression-sampling-full-swatch"></span>full-data fit</span></figcaption>
      <svg id="regression-sampling-lines" role="img" aria-label="Temperature and NOx observations with fitted regression lines"></svg>
    </figure>
    <figure class="clt-plot">
      <figcaption>Distribution of fitted slopes</figcaption>
      <svg id="regression-sampling-slopes" role="img" aria-label="Histogram of fitted regression slopes"></svg>
    </figure>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a href="index.qmd">← Return to Regression</a>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-explorer");
  if (!root) return;

  const sampleSizeInput = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-size");
  const totalSamplesInput = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-total");
  const batchSizeInput = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-batch");
  const addButton = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-add");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-run");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-reset");
  const status = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-status");
  const linesTitle = document.getElementById("regression-sampling-lines-title");

  const maxLinesToDraw = 100;
  const plottedObservationCount = 2500;
  let data = [];
  let plottedData = [];
  let fullFit = null;
  let fits = [];
  let dataReady = false;

  const clamp = (value, lower, upper) => Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value));
  const getSampleSize = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(sampleSizeInput.value, 10) || 300, 25, Math.min(2000, data.length || 2000));
  const getTotalSamples = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(totalSamplesInput.value, 10) || 100, 1, 1000);

  function svgElement(tag, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
  }

  function prepareSvg(id, height = 300) {
    const svg = document.getElementById(id);
    const width = Math.max(320, Math.round(svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 600));
    svg.replaceChildren();
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    return { svg, width, height, margin: { top: 22, right: 22, bottom: 42, left: 52 } };
  }

  function addAxes(chart, xDomain, yMaximum, xLabel, yLabel, decimals = 0) {
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const x = value => margin.left + ((value - xDomain[0]) / (xDomain[1] - xDomain[0])) * plotWidth;
    const y = value => margin.top + plotHeight - (value / yMaximum) * plotHeight;

    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: y(0), x2: width - margin.right, y2: y(0), class: "clt-axis" }));
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: y(0), class: "clt-axis" }));

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i += 1) {
      const xValue = xDomain[0] + (i / 4) * (xDomain[1] - xDomain[0]);
      const tickX = x(xValue);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: tickX, y1: y(0), x2: tickX, y2: y(0) + 4, class: "clt-axis" }));
      addText(svg, xValue.toFixed(decimals), tickX, height - 17, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }

    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i += 1) {
      const yValue = (i / 3) * yMaximum;
      const tickY = y(yValue);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left - 4, y1: tickY, x2: margin.left, y2: tickY, class: "clt-axis" }));
      addText(svg, yValue.toFixed(0), margin.left - 7, tickY + 4, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "end" });
    }

    addText(svg, xLabel, margin.left + plotWidth / 2, height - 3, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    const labelX = 14;
    const labelY = margin.top + plotHeight / 2;
    addText(svg, yLabel, labelX, labelY, {
      class: "clt-tick",
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: `rotate(-90 ${labelX} ${labelY})`
    });
    return { x, y };
  }

  function fitLine(points) {
    const n = points.length;
    const meanX = points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.at, 0) / n;
    const meanY = points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.nox, 0) / n;
    let sxx = 0;
    let sxy = 0;
    points.forEach(point => {
      const xDifference = point.at - meanX;
      sxx += xDifference ** 2;
      sxy += xDifference * (point.nox - meanY);
    });
    const slope = sxy / sxx;
    return { slope, intercept: meanY - slope * meanX };
  }

  function sampleRows(count) {
    const indices = new Set();
    while (indices.size < count) indices.add(Math.floor(Math.random() * data.length));
    return Array.from(indices, index => data[index]);
  }

  function histogram(values, domain, binCount) {
    const bins = Array.from({ length: binCount }, () => 0);
    const width = (domain[1] - domain[0]) / binCount;
    values.forEach(value => {
      const index = clamp(Math.floor((value - domain[0]) / width), 0, binCount - 1);
      bins[index] += 1;
    });
    return { bins, width };
  }

  function dataExtent(key) {
    const values = data.map(point => point[key]);
    return [Math.min(...values), Math.max(...values)];
  }

  function paddedDomain([minimum, maximum], fraction = 0.06) {
    const padding = Math.max(0.5, (maximum - minimum) * fraction);
    return [minimum - padding, maximum + padding];
  }

  function drawFittedLines() {
    const chart = prepareSvg("regression-sampling-lines");
    const xDomain = paddedDomain(dataExtent("at"));
    const yDomain = paddedDomain(dataExtent("nox"));
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const x = value => margin.left + ((value - xDomain[0]) / (xDomain[1] - xDomain[0])) * (width - margin.left - margin.right);
    const y = value => margin.top + plotHeight - ((value - yDomain[0]) / (yDomain[1] - yDomain[0])) * plotHeight;

    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: y(yDomain[0]), x2: width - margin.right, y2: y(yDomain[0]), class: "clt-axis" }));
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: y(yDomain[0]), class: "clt-axis" }));
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i += 1) {
      const xValue = xDomain[0] + (i / 4) * (xDomain[1] - xDomain[0]);
      const tickX = x(xValue);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: tickX, y1: y(yDomain[0]), x2: tickX, y2: y(yDomain[0]) + 4, class: "clt-axis" }));
      addText(svg, xValue.toFixed(0), tickX, height - 17, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i += 1) {
      const yValue = yDomain[0] + (i / 3) * (yDomain[1] - yDomain[0]);
      const tickY = y(yValue);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left - 4, y1: tickY, x2: margin.left, y2: tickY, class: "clt-axis" }));
      addText(svg, yValue.toFixed(0), margin.left - 7, tickY + 4, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "end" });
    }
    addText(svg, "Ambient temperature, AT (°C)", width / 2, height - 3, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    const labelX = 14;
    const labelY = margin.top + plotHeight / 2;
    addText(svg, "NOx concentration (mg/m³)", labelX, labelY, {
      class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle", transform: `rotate(-90 ${labelX} ${labelY})`
    });

    plottedData.forEach(point => {
      svg.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: x(point.at), cy: y(point.nox), r: 1.5, class: "regression-sampling-observation" }));
    });

    const visibleFits = fits.slice(-maxLinesToDraw);
    visibleFits.forEach(fit => {
      svg.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: x(xDomain[0]), y1: y(fit.intercept + fit.slope * xDomain[0]),
        x2: x(xDomain[1]), y2: y(fit.intercept + fit.slope * xDomain[1]),
        class: "regression-sampling-line"
      }));
    });
    svg.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: x(xDomain[0]), y1: y(fullFit.intercept + fullFit.slope * xDomain[0]),
      x2: x(xDomain[1]), y2: y(fullFit.intercept + fullFit.slope * xDomain[1]),
      class: "regression-sampling-full-line"
    }));

    if (!fits.length) {
      addText(svg, "Add samples to see fitted lines accumulate.", width / 2, height / 2, {
        class: "clt-empty-message", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    }
    linesTitle.textContent = fits.length <= maxLinesToDraw
      ? `${fits.length} fitted sample line${fits.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      : `${maxLinesToDraw} most recent fitted lines (of ${fits.length})`;
  }

  function drawSlopeHistogram() {
    const chart = prepareSvg("regression-sampling-slopes");
    const slopes = fits.map(fit => fit.slope);
    const referenceValues = slopes.length ? [...slopes, fullFit.slope] : [fullFit.slope - 0.15, fullFit.slope + 0.15];
    const rawMinimum = Math.min(...referenceValues);
    const rawMaximum = Math.max(...referenceValues);
    const padding = Math.max(0.02, (rawMaximum - rawMinimum) * 0.14);
    const domain = [rawMinimum - padding, rawMaximum + padding];
    const { bins, width: binWidth } = histogram(slopes, domain, 28);
    const maximum = Math.max(...bins, 1) * 1.12;
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const { x, y } = addAxes(chart, domain, maximum, "Fitted slope (mg/m³ per °C)", "number of samples", 2);

    bins.forEach((count, index) => {
      const start = domain[0] + index * binWidth;
      svg.append(svgElement("rect", {
        x: x(start) + 1,
        y: y(count),
        width: Math.max(1, x(start + binWidth) - x(start) - 2),
        height: y(0) - y(count),
        class: "regression-sampling-bar"
      }));
    });

    const fullSlopeX = x(fullFit.slope);
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: fullSlopeX, y1: margin.top, x2: fullSlopeX, y2: y(0), class: "regression-sampling-full-line" }));
    addText(svg, `full-data slope = ${fullFit.slope.toFixed(3)}`, Math.min(fullSlopeX + 5, width - 150), margin.top + 13, { class: "clt-annotation" });
    if (!fits.length) {
      addText(svg, "The distribution of fitted slopes will appear here.", width / 2, height / 2, {
        class: "clt-empty-message", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    }
  }

  function render() {
    if (!dataReady) return;
    const total = getTotalSamples();
    const completed = fits.length;
    const remaining = total - completed;
    drawFittedLines();
    drawSlopeHistogram();
    status.textContent = completed
      ? `${completed} of ${total} sample fits completed. Each fit uses ${getSampleSize()} paired operating-hour observations.`
      : `The full dataset contains ${data.length.toLocaleString()} operating hours. Add samples to begin.`;
    addButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
    runButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
    resetButton.disabled = false;
  }

  function addSamples(requested) {
    if (!dataReady) return;
    const total = getTotalSamples();
    const numberToAdd = Math.min(requested, Math.max(0, total - fits.length));
    const sampleSize = getSampleSize();
    for (let trial = 0; trial < numberToAdd; trial += 1) {
      fits.push(fitLine(sampleRows(sampleSize)));
    }
    render();
  }

  function reset() {
    if (!dataReady) return;
    sampleSizeInput.value = getSampleSize();
    totalSamplesInput.value = getTotalSamples();
    fits = [];
    render();
  }

  async function loadData() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("../data/gas-turbine-course.csv");
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      const rows = (await response.text()).trim().split(/\r?\n/);
      const header = rows.shift().split(",");
      const atIndex = header.indexOf("AT");
      const noxIndex = header.indexOf("NOX");
      data = rows.map(row => {
        const values = row.split(",");
        return { at: Number(values[atIndex]), nox: Number(values[noxIndex]) };
      }).filter(point => Number.isFinite(point.at) && Number.isFinite(point.nox));
      if (data.length < 25) throw new Error("Too few usable AT–NOx rows");
      plottedData = sampleRows(Math.min(plottedObservationCount, data.length));
      fullFit = fitLine(data);
      dataReady = true;
      reset();
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = `Unable to load the gas-turbine data (${error.message}). Render the Quarto site and try again.`;
    }
  }

  addButton.addEventListener("click", () => addSamples(Number.parseInt(batchSizeInput.value, 10)));
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => addSamples(getTotalSamples() - fits.length));
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", reset);
  [sampleSizeInput, totalSamplesInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener("change", reset));
  window.addEventListener("resize", render);
  loadData();
})();
</script>
